items.question: How does AI Tattoo Generator work?
items.answer: Upload a photo of the body part you want tattooed, describe your tattoo idea, and our AI generates a custom design then places it realistically on your photo. You'll see previews on all 4 body positions (left arm, right arm, shoulder, calf).

items.question: How many free previews can I try?
items.answer: Explore the real interactive example for free. New accounts receive 3 one-time credits after email verification. A complete set costs 1 credit at 1K, 2 at 2K, or 3 at 4K. Buy more credits on the pricing page when needed.

items.question: How realistic are the previews?
items.answer: Our AI uses advanced image-to-image technology to blend the tattoo design naturally onto your skin, accounting for lighting, skin texture, and body contours. While not 100% perfect, users tell us the results are remarkably accurate.

items.question: How long does generation take?
items.answer: Typically 3-5 minutes for a full set of 4 previews. The AI works in two steps: first designing the tattoo, then placing it on each body part.

items.question: What photo should I upload?
items.answer: A clear, well-lit photo of the body area where you want the tattoo. Avoid baggy clothing that covers the area. The better the photo, the better the preview.

items.question: Can I use the generated design at a tattoo shop?
items.answer: Absolutely! Many users take their AI-generated preview to their tattoo artist as a reference. It helps the artist understand exactly what you're looking for.
